rule.desc: 75 min pre-kick: best allowed-book price with EV >= 1% vs the leave-one-out median no-vig of >= 3 other books quoting the SAME point (any derivative market); one bet per game-market
early snapshot (Fri 21:40 UTC / kick-24h): EV >= 1% vs same-point other-book no-vig (pmf fallback when no other book has that point) AND EV >= 0 vs the sharp-full-game-implied anchored fair
hypothesis test of 'derivatives priced off the sharp full-game line': early snapshot, EV >= 8% vs Fair(sharp S,T) + rolling market level offset (key-number pmfs fit 2012-22)
